summary: Theme toggle feature testing completed. Fixed critical bug in FAQ.js where useTheme hook was not called inside the component. All pages now correctly display in both dark and light modes. Theme toggle button exists in header, theme persists via localStorage, and document class updates on toggle.

features_tested.details: Theme toggle button with data-testid='theme-toggle' exists in Navbar. Displays Sun icon in dark mode, Moon icon in light mode. Both desktop and mobile versions work.
Theme is stored in localStorage as 'brightluxx-theme' with values 'dark' or 'light'. Theme persists across page navigation.
Home page correctly displays in both dark (bg-[#050508]) and light (bg-white) modes. Logo changes based on theme. Stats and content sections update colors appropriately.
About page background changes: Dark mode uses bg-[#050508], light mode uses bg-neutral-50. All text, cards, and sections adapt to theme.
Contact page displays correctly in both modes. Form inputs, labels, and cards change styling based on theme.
Blog page with search, categories, and article cards all adapt to theme changes correctly.

CRITICAL BUG FIXED: FAQ.js was missing useTheme() hook call and theme-aware class definitions inside the component function. Added isDark, pageBg, textPrimary, textSecondary, textMuted, inputBg, inputBorder, inputText, borderColor variables.
Product Families page with comparison table and use case guide sections adapt to theme correctly.
Solutions page with solution cards, stats, and CTA sections display correctly in both modes.
Footer adapts to theme with appropriate background, text colors, and logo switching.

critical_code_review_comments: FAQ.js had a critical bug where theme-aware classes (pageBg, textPrimary, etc.) were referenced but not defined inside the component function - FIXED
ThemeContext.js correctly manages theme state with localStorage persistence and document class updates
Navbar.js correctly imports and uses useTheme hook with proper theme toggle button implementation
All pages now have consistent theme implementation using useTheme() hook
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme toggle feature is fully working. FAQ.js was fixed to properly use the useTheme hook. All pages (Home, About, Contact, Blog, FAQ, Product Families, Solutions, Footer) correctly display in both dark and light modes. Theme persists via localStorage with key 'brightluxx-theme'.

bug_fixed.issue: Missing useTheme hook call and theme-aware class definitions inside component function
bug_fixed.fix: Added const { isDark } = useTheme() and all theme-aware class definitions (pageBg, textPrimary, textSecondary, textMuted, inputBg, inputBorder, inputText, borderColor) inside the FAQ component function
